selectedCaption: 10-second tire check anyone can do at home. If you can see the top of Lincoln's head, it's time. Swing by — we'll check all four, no charge.
voiceoverScript: Your tires might be lying to you. Here's a ten-second check. Grab a penny, flip Lincoln upside down, and push it into the tread groove. See the top of his head? You're under two-thirty-seconds — legally bald. Tread wears uneven, so check three spots per tire: inside, center, outside. Bald tires nearly double your stopping distance on wet roads. Swing by 17625 Euclid — we'll check all four, no charge.
